modelEssay:
I support the proposal that every university student should learn the basics of academic writing. Such training is useful even for students who do not plan to become researchers.

First, it teaches us to connect a claim with evidence. When writing a report, we need to explain what our information shows and what it cannot prove. This habit can make our arguments clearer. Second, learning to acknowledge sources helps us distinguish our own ideas from those of other writers. A short assignment based on two articles would give students practical experience with this skill.

However, the course should be adapted to different majors. Engineering students could explain a design decision, while history students could compare accounts of an event. The university should also keep the workload reasonable and provide feedback on a draft.

A basic course with relevant tasks would therefore be more valuable than one that merely asks students to memorize formal phrases.
modelEssayZh: 我支持让每一位大学生学习学术写作基础的提议。即使对于不打算成为研究人员的学生，这种训练也有用。
首先，它教我们把观点与证据联系起来。写报告时，我们需要解释资料说明了什么，以及它不能证明什么。这种习惯有助于让论证更清楚。其次，学习注明来源，能帮助我们区分自己的想法与其他作者的想法。一份基于两篇文章的简短作业，可以让学生实际练习这项技能。
不过，课程应按不同专业作调整。工程专业学生可以解释一项设计决定，历史专业学生则可以比较对同一事件的不同记述。学校还应让作业量保持合理，并对初稿提供反馈。
因此，包含相关任务的基础课程，会比仅要求学生记忆正式表达的课程更有价值。

modelEssay:
In my view, College Chinese should be a compulsory course, provided that it offers useful tasks and a reasonable workload. University students need opportunities to improve their reading and communication in their first language as well as in English.

One benefit is learning to read complex texts carefully. Students could compare two articles on the same issue and explain where the writers disagree. Another benefit is clearer expression. For example, revising a confusing notice would help students consider what readers actually need to know. These activities would be more useful than simply memorizing facts about famous writers.

Still, students already have demanding courses in their own majors. College Chinese should therefore be a short foundation course, with some choice of reading materials. Assessment could include a reading response and a revised piece of writing.

With this practical design, making the course compulsory would give all students opportunities to practise skills that they can use beyond the classroom.
modelEssayZh: 在我看来，只要课程安排实用任务、作业量合理，大学语文就应成为必修课。大学生需要机会提高母语及英语的阅读和沟通能力。
一个好处是学习仔细阅读复杂文本。学生可以比较讨论同一问题的两篇文章，说明作者的分歧所在。另一个好处是表达更清楚。例如，修改一则难懂的通知，有助于让学生考虑读者真正需要知道什么。这些活动会比单纯记忆著名作家的相关知识更有用。
不过，学生本专业的课程已经很繁重。因此，大学语文应是一门简短的基础课程，并让学生对阅读材料有一定选择。考核可以包括一份阅读回应和一篇修改后的文章。
采用这种实用的设计，将课程设为必修课，就能让所有学生都有机会练习可用于课堂之外的技能。

Students can contribute to a green campus by changing daily habits and making it easier for others to do the same. A useful starting point is reducing waste in places we visit every day.

In the canteen, we can choose smaller portions and ask for more only when needed. This can reduce the amount of food left on our plates. In classrooms, the last person to leave should check the lights and other equipment. These simple actions connect environmental concerns with specific routines.

Students can also work together. A monthly exchange table would allow us to pass on books and other usable items instead of throwing them away. Volunteers could explain the rules and keep the area tidy. If drinking water stations are inconvenient, we could collect suggestions and discuss improvements with the university.

A green campus depends on regular participation. Choosing a few practical actions and checking whether they are being followed is more useful than organizing a campaign that ends after one day.
modelEssayZh: 学生可以通过改变日常习惯，并让其他人更容易采取同样的行动，为绿色校园作贡献。一个实用的起点，是减少我们每天都会去的地方所产生的浪费。
在食堂，我们可以先取小份食物，只有需要时再加。这能减少餐盘中剩下的食物。在教室里，最后离开的人应检查灯和其他设备。这些简单行动，把环保关切落实到具体的日常做法中。
学生也可以共同参与。每月设置一次物品交换摊位，能让我们把书籍和其他仍可用的物品转交给别人，而不是扔掉。志愿者可以解释规则，保持场地整洁。如果饮水点使用不方便，我们可以收集建议，与学校讨论改进办法。
绿色校园依赖持续参与。选择几项可行的行动，并检查人们是否坚持执行，比组织一场一天就结束的活动更有用。

expressions.exampleZh: 共享仍可使用的物品，可以减少校园产生的废物量。

expressions.text: make it easier for others to do

expressions.patternZh: “使某人做某事更容易”：it 是形式宾语，后面的动词不定式说明具体做什么。

exercise.transferPrompt: 教学自拟：校园食堂如何减少食物浪费？先写一个可执行建议，再解释学生为什么可能愿意参加。

title: 大学图书馆是否应向公众开放

sources.title: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题及答案（卷一）
sources.note: 教育机构公开排版整理；题干核验为大学图书馆是否向公众开放。正文 Directions 写作时长为 30 分钟，页面 Part I 标题出现 25 分钟的不一致，采用 Directions 要求。

prompt: 学校征求学生意见：大学图书馆是否应向公众开放？请写一篇短文说明你的观点。
promptZh: 学校征求学生意见：大学图书馆是否应向公众开放？请写一篇短文说明你的观点。
directions: Your university seeks student opinions about allowing the general public to use its library. Write an essay explaining your view on public access. Finish within 30 minutes, using 120 to 180 words.
directionsZh: 学校正在征求学生对允许公众使用大学图书馆的意见。请写一篇短文，说明你对向公众开放的看法。限时30分钟，120至180词。
directionsNote: 依据所列公开题源忠实整理，以下英文为任务要求的改写，并非试卷逐字原文。30 分钟；全文计词，无需给定首句。

task.situation: 学校在决定大学图书馆是否向公众开放时征求学生意见。
task.objective: 明确开放立场，解释收益与对学生服务的影响。
requirements: 回应大学图书馆面向公众开放的问题

optionalIdeas: 公众阅读和教育机会
座位、开放时段、预约和身份登记
保护学生学习资源与安全管理
avoid: 写成图书馆服务提案而没有回答是否开放
把向公众开放等同于免费开放全部收费数据库
声称没有任何管理成本或风险

routes.label: 支持有条件开放
outline: 明确支持适度开放
解释公共阅读收益
承认容量有限
用时段和预约保障学生资源

reasoning.claim: 开放能扩大资源的受益范围，但需要保障学生服务。
reasoning.claimZh: 开放能扩大资源的受益范围，但需要保障学生服务。
reasoning.mechanism: 公众得到阅读机会；高峰时段限制或预约可以减少资源冲突。
reasoning.mechanismZh: 公众得到阅读机会；高峰时段限制或预约可以减少资源冲突。
reasoning.example: 普通周末试行有限预约，考试周保留主要学习空间。
reasoning.exampleZh: 普通周末试行有限预约，考试周保留主要学习空间。
reasoning.link: 因此，支持开放的立场可以包含必要条件。
reasoning.linkZh: 因此，支持开放的立场可以包含必要条件。

modelEssay:
I believe our university library should be open to the public under clear rules. Sharing some of its resources could benefit local residents without preventing students from studying effectively.

The library has books that many people cannot easily obtain elsewhere. Allowing visitors to read them would create more opportunities for learning. It could also encourage useful contact between the university and the surrounding community.

However, space is limited, especially before examinations. The university should begin with a small pilot programme during quieter periods. Visitors could book places in advance and follow the same rules on noise and the use of materials as students. During examination weeks, most study spaces should remain available to students. Access to paid online resources would require separate consideration.

After the trial, the library could collect feedback from both groups and check how its services have been affected. Public access would then be a decision based on actual use rather than a promise to open every resource at once.
modelEssayZh: 我认为，我们大学的图书馆应在明确规则下向公众开放。共享部分资源，可能既能让当地居民受益，又不妨碍学生有效地学习。
图书馆有一些许多人在其他地方不容易获取的书。允许访客阅读这些书，会创造更多学习机会。这也可能促进学校与周边社区之间有益的联系。
不过，空间有限，尤其是在考试前。学校应先在较清闲的时段开展小规模试点。访客可以提前预约名额，并遵守与学生相同的噪声和资料使用规则。在考试周，大部分学习空间应留给学生使用。付费在线资源的使用权限，则需要另行考虑。
试行后，图书馆可以收集双方的反馈，检查服务受到了什么影响。这样，是否向公众开放就会成为基于实际使用情况的决定，而不是一次性开放所有资源的承诺。
modelNotes: 参考作文 163 词：按本工具英文词项规则计数，缩写、所有格与连字符复合词计作一词；本题全文均计入。
原创参考作文；开放规则、试点安排为作者的建议，不是试卷给定事实。
教学评估题：先独立写作再阅读范文。
有效观点可以是支持、反对或有条件支持；不能用统一立场判对错。

expressions.pattern: under + 名词短语，说明制度或条件；规则内容应随后写清。
expressions.patternZh: under 后接名词短语，表示在某种制度或条件下；随后应说明具体规则。
expressions.example: Public access could be introduced under clear rules.
expressions.exampleZh: 可以在明确规则下向公众开放图书馆。
expressions.boundary: 不能用这个短语代替全部实施细节；管理规则仍需兼顾容量、身份和资源权限。

expressions.pattern: book + 可数宾语；in advance 表示提前。
expressions.patternZh: book 表示预约，后接可数的预约对象；in advance 表示提前。
expressions.example: Visitors could book places in advance during the trial.
expressions.exampleZh: 在试行期间，访客可以提前预约名额。
expressions.boundary: book 是预约，不是保证能获得所有资源；若指房间、时段，应相应写 book a room/a time slot。

exercise.weakParagraph: The library should open because reading is good. Everybody can go there. There will be no problems.
exercise.weakParagraphZh: 图书馆应该开放，因为阅读有好处。每个人都可以去那里。不会出现任何问题。
exercise.improvedParagraph: Opening the library during quieter periods could give local residents more opportunities to read. However, study spaces are limited. A booking system would allow the library to control visitor numbers while protecting students' access.
exercise.improvedParagraphZh: 在较清闲的时段开放图书馆，可能让当地居民获得更多阅读机会。不过，学习空间有限。预约制度可以让图书馆控制访客人数，同时保障学生的使用机会。
exercise.explanation: 补充收益、容量限制和应对方法；把无依据的“没有问题”换成可检查的实施条件。
exercise.transferPrompt: 教学自拟：学校体育场是否应向社区居民开放？独立写出立场、理由和一个需要处理的限制。
exercise.transferHint: 重新考虑设施安全、维护、课程时段；不要直接套用付费数据库等图书馆专属条件。
exercise.boundaryPrompt: The library should give every visitor free access to all online databases. 这个主张为什么需要谨慎？
exercise.boundaryAnswer: 公众到馆阅读不自动意味着学校有权开放全部付费数据库。需要考虑订阅许可、管理资源和题干范围，可建议另行评估。

commonErrors.wrong: The library should open to public.
commonErrors.wrongZh: 图书馆应该向公众开放。
commonErrors.right: The library should be open to the public.
commonErrors.rightZh: 图书馆应该向公众开放。
commonErrors.why: be open 表示开放状态；the public 是常见名词表达，意为公众。

commonErrors.wrong: Visitors should obey to the rules.
commonErrors.wrongZh: 访客应该遵守规则。
commonErrors.right: Visitors should follow the rules.
commonErrors.rightZh: 访客应该遵守规则。

title: 社区服务的益处与我能提供的服务

sources.title: 大学英语四级考试真题全解+标准预测（备战2024.12）目录与样章
sources.publisher: 外语教学与研究出版社公开样章
sources.note: 出版社公开样章含 2023 年 6 月作文卷面整理；题目要求同时写益处与自己能够提供的服务。非官方原卷。

prompt: 学生会组织大学生参加社区服务的线上讨论。写一篇短文，说明社区服务的益处，以及你能提供什么服务。
promptZh: 学生会组织大学生参加社区服务的线上讨论。写一篇短文，说明社区服务的益处，以及你能提供什么服务。
directions: For a Student Union online discussion, write an essay about university students serving their communities. Explain the benefits of community service and identify services you personally could provide. Use 120 to 180 words and complete it in 30 minutes.
directionsZh: 请为学生会组织的线上讨论写一篇短文，讨论大学生为社区提供服务。说明社区服务的益处，并指出你自己可以提供哪些服务。限时30分钟，120至180词。
directionsNote: 依据所列公开题源忠实整理，以下英文为任务要求的改写，并非试卷逐字原文。30 分钟；全文计词，无需给定首句。

task.situation: 在学生会线上讨论中谈大学生参与社区服务。
task.objective: 同时解释服务价值与自身可贡献的具体服务。
requirements: 讨论大学生社区服务的益处
说明自己能够提供的服务
写成 120–180 词的讨论短文
optionalIdeas: 针对不同居民的真实需要
把专业、技能和服务相联系
安排持续参与与居民反馈
avoid: 只列大学生获得的好处而遗漏自己提供的服务
把志愿者写成能够提供任何专业服务
只有 help people 等泛泛表述

routes.label: 数字技能支持：需要与能力相匹配
outline: 概括居民与学生双方的益处
用解释任务说明沟通训练
写自己可提供的基础手机操作帮助
说明持续时间、沟通方式和能力边界

routes.label: 课后学习陪伴：从稳定的小任务入手
outline: 解释服务给居民带来的帮助
说明备课和倾听的学习价值
提出自己擅长学科的基础辅导
说明可靠安排与家长反馈

reasoning.claim: 社区服务可以帮助学生理解不同人的需要。
reasoning.claimZh: 社区服务可以帮助学生理解不同人的需要。
reasoning.mechanism: 面对真实问题时，志愿者需要倾听、调整解释方式，而非只完成课堂任务。
reasoning.mechanismZh: 面对真实问题时，志愿者需要倾听、调整解释方式，而非只完成课堂任务。
reasoning.example: 为老年人讲解手机操作时，先观察他们在哪一步感到困难。
reasoning.exampleZh: 为老年人讲解手机操作时，先观察他们在哪一步感到困难。
reasoning.link: 沟通能力的可能收益来自具体互动，不是参加活动自动产生。
reasoning.linkZh: 沟通能力的可能收益来自具体互动，不是参加活动自动产生。

reasoning.claim: 服务应与自己现有能力匹配。
reasoning.claimZh: 服务应与自己现有能力匹配。
reasoning.mechanism: 限定任务并稳定参与，比承诺复杂但无能力完成的服务更可靠。
reasoning.mechanismZh: 限定任务并稳定参与，比承诺复杂但无能力完成的服务更可靠。
reasoning.example: 每周帮居民练习发消息或使用地图，但不处理账号密码和金融事务。
reasoning.exampleZh: 每周帮居民练习发消息或使用地图，但不处理账号密码和金融事务。
reasoning.link: 这种安排既回应“我能提供什么”，也让方案可信。
reasoning.linkZh: 这种安排既回应“我能提供什么”，也让方案可信。

modelEssay:
Community service can benefit both local residents and university students. Residents receive practical support, while students have opportunities to understand needs that are different from their own.

For students, the experience can develop communication skills. Explaining a task to someone with little experience requires patience and clear language. Listening to residents also helps us see whether our ideas are actually useful, rather than simply assuming that they are.

I could help older residents learn basic phone skills at the community centre. For example, I could show them how to send messages or find a bus route. I would prepare simple instructions and let each person practise at their own pace. I would not handle passwords or offer financial advice, since these tasks require different expertise.

To make the service reliable, I could volunteer for an hour each week and ask participants what they want to learn next. A small service that meets a real need would be more helpful than a large promise that I cannot keep.
modelEssayZh: 社区服务可以使当地居民和大学生双方受益。居民得到实际帮助，学生则有机会了解与自己不同的需求。
对学生来说，这种经历可以培养沟通技能。向缺乏相关经验的人解释一项任务，需要耐心和清楚的语言。倾听居民的意见，也有助于我们判断自己的想法是否真的有用，而不是直接假定它们有用。
我可以在社区中心帮助老年居民学习基本的手机操作。例如，我可以向他们演示如何发消息或查找公交路线。我会准备简单的操作说明，让每个人按自己的速度练习。我不会处理密码或提供财务建议，因为这些任务需要不同的专业知识。
为了让服务可靠，我可以每周做一小时志愿服务，并询问参与者接下来想学什么。满足真实需要的小规模服务，会比我无法兑现的大承诺更有帮助。
modelNotes: 参考作文 167 词：按本工具英文词项规则计数，缩写、所有格与连字符复合词计作一词；本题全文均计入。
原创参考作文；社区中心、服务计划均为示范情境。
两项题干任务都被回应：益处与个人服务。只写志愿服务重要性会漏项。
at their own pace 指按自己的速度练习，不等于缺少目标和反馈。

expressions.pattern: meet + need；need 可数，此处用 a real need。
expressions.patternZh: meet 在这里表示满足，后接 need；need 可以计数，这里表示“一项真实需要”。
expressions.example: A useful volunteer project should meet a real need in the community.
expressions.exampleZh: 有用的志愿项目应满足社区的一项真实需要。
expressions.boundary: 需要应具体，并可由交流或观察支持；不能把志愿者自己的兴趣自动当作居民需要。

expressions.pattern: at + one's own pace；代词与前文的人保持一致。
expressions.patternZh: 表示“按某人自己的速度”；代词要与前文所指的人一致。
expressions.example: Older learners can practise basic phone skills at their own pace.
expressions.exampleZh: 年长的学习者可以按自己的速度练习基本的手机操作。
expressions.boundary: 适合练习或学习节奏；不表示可以忽略服务时限，也不等于学习效果保证。

exercise.weakParagraph: Community service is good for us. It can improve our skills and make us happy. I can help people do many things.
exercise.weakParagraphZh: 社区服务对我们有好处。它能提高我们的技能，让我们开心。我可以帮助别人做很多事情。
exercise.improvedParagraph: Helping residents with basic phone tasks would give me practice in explaining ideas clearly. I could prepare simple instructions for sending messages and let residents try each step themselves. This would provide practical support while helping me learn to listen.

modelEssay:
The campus event that impressed me most was a repair workshop held in our student centre last autumn. Students brought simple objects that no longer worked and learned how to examine them with experienced volunteers.

I arrived with a desk lamp and expected someone else to fix it for me. Instead, a volunteer asked me to describe the problem and check each possible cause. When I got stuck, she demonstrated one step and then let me try it myself. With her guidance, I found a loose connection.

What made the event memorable was not just taking a working lamp home. I discovered that asking a clear question and trying a small step could make an unfamiliar task less frightening. Since then, I have been more willing to ask for explanations in class.

The workshop gave me a useful experience of learning through patient guidance. It reminded me that practical activities can sometimes change our habits as well as teach us a skill.
modelEssayZh: 最令我印象深刻的校园活动，是去年秋天在学生中心举行的一次维修工作坊。学生带来一些已经不能使用的简单物品，向有经验的志愿者学习如何检查它们。
我带着一盏台灯来到现场，原以为别人会替我修好它。但一位志愿者让我先描述问题，再逐一检查可能的原因。遇到困难时，她示范一步，然后让我自己尝试。在她的指导下，我找到了一处松动的连接。
这次活动之所以难忘，不只是因为我带回了一盏能用的灯。我发现，提出一个清楚的问题，再尝试迈出一小步，可以让陌生任务不那么令人害怕。从那以后，我在课堂上更愿意请求别人解释。
工作坊让我经历了一次在耐心指导下学习的过程。它提醒我，实践活动有时既能教会我们一项技能，也能改变我们的习惯。
modelNotes: 参考作文 162 词：按本工具英文词项规则计数，缩写、所有格与连字符复合词计作一词；本题全文均计入。
原创参考作文；工作坊、台灯与人物细节为教学示范，不是考题事实。
文章聚焦单次活动，转折点与活动后的行为变化支持印象深刻的原因。
过去活动用过去时，持续影响可用现在完成时；不必把所有句子强行统一时态。

expressions.pattern: What + 从句构成主语；was 后接名词或名词化结构。
expressions.patternZh: what 引导的从句作主语，表示“让活动难忘的事情”；was 后接名词或相当于名词的表达。
expressions.example: What made the event memorable was the chance to solve a problem myself.
expressions.exampleZh: 让这次活动难忘的，是自己解决问题的机会。
expressions.boundary: 需要给出实际原因；这种句式适合聚焦，不必在每段重复以制造复杂度。

expressions.pattern: be + more willing + to do；willing 描述人的意愿。
expressions.patternZh: 表示“更愿意做……”：后接动词不定式；willing 描述人的意愿。
expressions.example: After the workshop, I was more willing to ask questions.
expressions.exampleZh: 工作坊结束后，我更愿意提问了。
expressions.boundary: 表达意愿变化，不等于能力已经提高或行为永远改变；只有比较情境清楚时 more 才有依据。

commonErrors.right: I attended the workshop last autumn.

modelEssay:
I would like to propose two improvements to our library services. They address difficulties that students may face when looking for resources and arranging their study time.

First, new students often need guidance on using the catalogue. A short search guide on the library website, together with brief demonstrations at the beginning of term, would help them find materials independently. Staff could also collect common questions and use them to improve the guide.

Second, some students have classes late in the afternoon and find the evening opening hours too short. The library could try staying open for one extra hour on weekdays for a month. Recording visitor numbers would help staff decide whether the change is worth the additional cost.

These suggestions do not require every service to be changed at once. I recommend a small trial, followed by feedback from students and library staff. This would allow the library to identify which improvements are genuinely useful before committing more resources.
modelEssayZh: 我想为图书馆服务提出两项改进。它们针对学生查找资源和安排学习时间时可能遇到的困难。
首先，新生往往需要有人指导他们使用目录。图书馆网站上的简短检索指南，加上学期开始时的简要演示，可以帮助他们独立查找资料。工作人员还可以收集常见问题，用来改进指南。
其次，有些学生下午较晚还有课，觉得晚间开放时间太短。图书馆可以试行在工作日多开放一小时，持续一个月。记录到馆人数，有助于工作人员判断这项改变是否值得付出额外成本。
这些建议并不要求所有服务同时改变。我建议先进行小规模试行，再收集学生和图书馆工作人员的反馈。这样，图书馆可以在投入更多资源前，确定哪些改进真正有用。

modelEssay:
I propose a two-day orientation programme to help new students become familiar with campus life and prepare for university study. Senior students and academic advisers could work together to provide practical guidance.

On the first day, small groups would visit essential places such as the library and student support centre. Each group would also meet a student mentor who could answer everyday questions. A simple campus task, such as finding a book, would help participants use the information immediately.

The second day would focus on learning. Advisers could explain how to read course requirements and plan a week's study. Students would then make a sample timetable and discuss it in pairs. This activity would give them a chance to ask questions before classes become demanding.

The programme should end with clear contact details for further support. Mentors could check in after a month to find out what difficulties remain. In this way, orientation would begin an ongoing process of adjustment rather than end with a campus tour.
modelEssayZh: 我提议开展一个为期两天的迎新项目，帮助新生熟悉校园生活，为大学学习做好准备。高年级学生和学业导师可以共同提供实用指导。
第一天，小组会参观图书馆、学生支持中心等重要地点。每组还会见到一位能解答日常问题的学生导师。找一本书之类的简单校园任务，可以帮助参与者立即运用刚得到的信息。
第二天的重点是学习。学业导师可以解释如何阅读课程要求、安排一周的学习。学生随后制作一份示例时间表，并两人一组讨论。在课程变得繁重之前，这项活动会给他们提问的机会。
项目结束时应提供清楚的联系方式，方便学生继续寻求帮助。导师可以在一个月后跟进，了解还有哪些困难。这样，迎新就会开启一个持续适应的过程，而不是在参观校园后就结束。

modelEssay:
Dear Alex,

I am glad to hear that you want to learn Chinese. I would suggest looking for a university language centre in Hangzhou. The city would offer a setting in which you could combine lessons with everyday practice.

A suitable beginner course could help you build basic vocabulary and receive guidance on pronunciation. Before enrolling, check that the class matches your level and gives students opportunities to speak. Regular feedback would be more useful than a course that only asks you to memorize words.

Outside class, you could practise simple conversations in familiar places, such as a nearby shop. Start with short tasks and keep a record of expressions that you find useful. Having classmates to practise with would also make the experience easier.

Please compare the course arrangements and costs before making a decision. If you tell me your current level and available time, I can help you think through the options.

Best wishes,
Li Hua
modelEssayZh: 亲爱的亚历克斯：
很高兴听说你想学中文。我建议你在杭州寻找一所大学的语言中心。这座城市可以提供一个把课堂学习与日常练习结合起来的环境。
合适的初级课程可以帮助你积累基础词汇，并得到发音指导。报名之前，要确认课程适合你的水平，也给学生提供开口练习的机会。定期反馈，会比只要求你背单词的课程更有用。
课外，你可以在熟悉的地方，比如附近的商店，练习简单对话。先从简短任务开始，并记录你觉得有用的表达。有同学一起练习，也会让学习经历更轻松。
请在决定之前比较课程安排和费用。如果你告诉我目前的水平和可用时间，我可以帮你仔细考虑不同选择。
祝好！
李华

modelEssay:
The Student Union organised a visit to a local farm last Saturday, giving students an opportunity to learn about food production beyond the classroom. The group spent the morning observing farm work and talking with staff.

The visit began with an introduction to the crops grown on the farm. A worker then explained how the team checked soil conditions and planned watering. Students asked questions about the differences between the methods used for various crops. They also joined a short activity sorting vegetables, which helped them see why careful handling matters before food reaches a shop.

At the end of the visit, the organisers invited students to share what they had learned. Several participants described a better understanding of the work behind everyday meals. The Student Union plans to publish their short reports on its website so that other students can learn from the visit.

The activity connected classroom knowledge with a local workplace and encouraged further questions about agriculture.
modelEssayZh: 学生会上周六组织了一次当地农场参观，让学生有机会在课堂之外了解食品生产。同学们用一上午观察农场工作，并与工作人员交流。
参观首先介绍了农场种植的作物。随后，一位工作人员说明团队如何检查土壤状况、规划浇水。学生提问，了解不同作物所用方法的差异。他们还参加了一次简短的蔬菜分拣活动，这有助于他们理解，食品到达商店之前为什么需要小心处理。
参观结束时，组织者邀请学生分享学到的内容。几位参与者表示，他们更加理解了日常饭菜背后付出的劳动。学生会计划在网站上发布他们的简短报告，让其他同学也能从这次参观中学习。
这次活动把课堂知识与当地工作场所联系起来，也鼓励大家进一步提出有关农业的问题。
modelNotes: 参考作文 160 词：按本工具英文词项规则计数，缩写、所有格与连字符复合词计作一词；本题全文均计入。
原创新闻写作示范；时间、活动过程、参与者回应与后续计划为虚构教学细节，不是实际采访记录。
新闻导语先交代组织者、事件、地点类别和时间，再写过程和结果。
题干没有要求具体人数、数字或引语；无需伪造统计来增强可信度。

expressions.pattern: give + 人 + an opportunity + to do；an opportunity 后也可接 for + 名词。
expressions.patternZh: 表示“给某人做某事的机会”；opportunity 后接动词不定式，也可以用 for 接名词。
expressions.example: The visit gave students an opportunity to observe farm work.
expressions.exampleZh: 这次参观给了学生观察农场工作的机会。
expressions.boundary: 适合活动提供的学习机会；不能直接把机会等同于专业技能已经掌握。

expressions.pattern: learn about + 主题名词；learn to do 表示学会做一项技能。
expressions.patternZh: “了解……”后接主题名词；“学会做……”则用 to 后接动词原形。
expressions.example: Students learned about food production by talking with farm workers.
expressions.exampleZh: 学生通过与农场工作人员交谈，了解了食品生产。
expressions.boundary: 参观了解用 learn about 更准确；未实际完成技能训练时不宜写 learned to run a farm。

exercise.weakParagraph: Agriculture is important in modern society. Farms are good places. We should visit farms because they are useful.
exercise.weakParagraphZh: 农业在现代社会很重要。农场是好地方。我们应该参观农场，因为它们很有用。
exercise.improvedParagraph: The Student Union organised a visit to a local farm last Saturday. During the morning tour, farm workers explained how they planned watering and handled vegetables. Students asked questions about the work involved in producing everyday food.
exercise.improvedParagraphZh: 学生会上周六组织了一次当地农场参观。上午参观时，农场工作人员介绍了如何规划浇水、处理蔬菜。学生询问了生产日常食物所涉及的工作。
exercise.explanation: 从泛泛议论转为事件导语和过程信息；保留组织者、农场参观与新闻读者需要。细节为教学自拟，不是题干事实。
exercise.transferPrompt: 教学自拟：为校报报道学生会组织的一次当地博物馆参观。独立写导语和一个过程段落。
exercise.transferHint: 改成博物馆具体活动与可获得的信息，保持组织者、时间、事件清楚；不要原样移植农作物细节。
exercise.boundaryPrompt: 用 I had a wonderful time and hope you will come next time 结束新闻报道合适吗？
exercise.boundaryAnswer: 更像日记或邀请。新闻可以报道参与者的体验或组织者后续计划，但应保持事件信息和适合校报的语气。

commonErrors.wrong: The visit was organized by Student Union.
commonErrors.wrongZh: 这次参观由学生会组织。
commonErrors.right: The visit was organised by the Student Union.
commonErrors.rightZh: 这次参观由学生会组织。
commonErrors.why: 具体学生会通常用 the Student Union；英美拼写 organised/organized 均可，全文保持一致。

commonErrors.wrong: Students learned to food production.
commonErrors.wrongZh: 学生学会了“食品生产”。
commonErrors.right: Students learned about food production.
commonErrors.rightZh: 学生了解了食品生产。
commonErrors.why: learn about 后接主题名词；learn to 后接动词原形。
